purpose: Execute the exact Generation-2 evidence boundary required by terminal predecessor d62224bf: real locally generated TTS waveform bytes -> actual owner-VPS PipeWire virtual/null sink -> monitor capture/readback -> existing causal barge/cancel boundary. Measure and bound old-packet audio tail after cancel. No physical speaker or human-heard credit.

predecessor.gap_advanced_here: The prior sink was logical/headless. It did not prove what reached an actual audio graph/monitor after cancellation.

external_primary_basis.finding: PipeWire's PulseAudio emulation supports built-in module-null-sink and permits loading it through pactl with sink_name, format, rate and channels.
pw-record can bind capture to an explicit node target by object.serial or node.name, enabling identity-bound monitor capture.

sandbox_reason: PipeWire user/service/session and virtual audio-node fidelity are required, but no physical device is required. S4 is therefore premature.
required_preflight: Positively identify disposable S2 sandbox and preserve host-survival fence.
Confirm pipewire, pipewire-pulse, pactl and pw-record/pw-play or equivalent admitted clients are installed in the sandbox only.
Bind exact current F2 source SHA, exact local TTS runtime/binary/model hashes, and exact generated German waveform SHA256 before playback.
Record PipeWire version, session-manager version, user/session identity, node list and clock/quantum/latency properties before execution.
Do not change owner-host default audio devices; create and destroy only sandbox-local virtual nodes.

virtual_graph.identity_rule: Discover and record the resulting sink and monitor node names/object.serial values; do not assume a monitor identifier without enumeration.
virtual_graph.capture_rule: Bind pw-record (or an equivalent exact PipeWire capture client) to the enumerated monitor node by stable run-local identity.
virtual_graph.playback_rule: Route only the exact old-output packet waveform to the enumerated f2_voice_g2_sink; record playback stream/node identity and packet id.
virtual_graph.cleanup_rule: Unload the created null-sink module and terminate run-owned capture/playback clients; verify no run-owned node remains.

method: Generate or reuse the exact locally generated long German TTS waveform bound to one VoiceOutputPacket old-output lineage.
Start monitor recording before playback and capture the entire virtual-sink playback plus a short post-roll.
Record monotonic timestamps for capture-ready, playback-start and playback-end.
Hash source waveform and monitor capture; decode both to normalized PCM for alignment/correlation while preserving raw hashes.
two_run_discriminator.required_result: Establish that the virtual graph actually carries the generated waveform and measure graph/sample-rate/latency transformation. If control readback cannot be identity/alignment-bound, cancellation evidence is invalid rather than negative.

method: Replay the identical source waveform through the identical virtual graph and output-packet lineage class.
At a deterministic measured boundary after playback has begun, invoke the existing admitted barge/cancel path for that exact output packet; do not merely stop the monitor recorder.
Keep monitor capture running through a post-cancel window substantially longer than the observed graph latency/quantum.
Record cancel-request timestamp, output-packet terminal-state timestamp, playback-client stop/terminal timestamp, monitor samples and all relevant PipeWire node/stream state.
Align cancel-run monitor PCM to the full-control monitor/source. Measure the last sample window still attributable to the old packet and compute cancel-to-last-old-sample tail duration.
two_run_discriminator.required_result: Old-packet audio may exist only inside an explicitly measured bounded in-flight tail caused by already-buffered graph data. No source-correlated old-packet samples may continue after that measured tail bound, and the interrupted packet must remain non-commit-eligible.

acceptance_invariants: CONTROL_VALID: full-playback monitor capture is demonstrably derived from the exact local TTS waveform and exact virtual-sink graph; otherwise return EVIDENCE_INVALID.
CAUSAL_CANCEL: the existing output packet's admitted cancel/barge boundary is what terminates playback authority; stopping capture alone cannot satisfy the test.
BOUNDED_TAIL: cancel-to-last-old-sample is measured, finite and explained by observed graph buffering/latency rather than guessed.
NO_POST_BOUND_OLD_AUDIO: after the measured bounded in-flight tail, monitor readback contains no continuing old-packet source-correlated audio.
PACKET_FENCE: interrupted output remains non-commit-eligible and cannot later become heard/commit-authoritative merely because buffered samples existed before cancellation.
CLEANUP: run-owned sink/capture/playback nodes terminate and are removed without mutating owner-host audio state.
route_to_trigger4: Trigger 4 owns execution/integration. Refresh main and current mutation/runtime ownership, then implement only the smallest adapter/harness needed to connect the existing output packet/cancel path to the sandbox-local PipeWire graph. New Voice authority is forbidden. Persist raw source/capture hashes, exact commands, node identities, timing, PCM analysis and negative evidence.
next_after_terminal_g2: Only after this G2 is terminal should Trigger 7 re-evaluate and claim the next nonduplicate VPS depth (true realtime ASR partials, namespace-offline inference, producer preemption if still zero, bounded long-session stress) based on then-current granular state.
